# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def flatten(x: Any) -> list[Any]:
    """Flatten arbitrarily nested lists and tuples into a single flat list, in order.

    Strings, bytes and dicts are leaves and must not be split apart.
    """
    if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)):
        result: list[Any] = []
        for item in x:
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        return result
    return [x]
